card.name: Eye-symptom lists in ophthalmic warnings
card.fires_on: Commas, 'e.g.,' and 'and' inside lists of eye symptoms or eye conditions, such as retinal detachment, eye pain, vision loss or dilated pupils. It also fires partway through 'Hypopyon' in eye-grading tables.

modes.label: Punctuation in eye-symptom lists
modes.description: A comma or 'e.g.,' right after an eye symptom or condition, where the next item is another eye term.
modes.example: report any symptoms suggestive of endophthalmitis or retinal detachment (e.g., vision loss, eye pain, redness of the eye<<,>> photophobia, blurring of vision)

modes.label: Eye grading and dose tables
modes.description: A word piece or punctuation in ocular inflammation tables for dose changes.
modes.example: 3+ Cell or Flare in anterior chamber Withhold until Grade 1 or less, then reduce dose by one dose level. Grade 4/<< Hyp>>opyon Permanently discontinue.

card.writes: It suppresses eye-related words such as eye, eyes and vision, so the model is less likely to repeat an eye word right after the list punctuation.
card.plain: It fires on the commas and linking words in lists of eye symptoms, just before another eye term would come next.
